$comment: GitHub usernames explicitly marked trusted. Read by tools/build_catalog.py: an entry is trusted when its "author" field matches a key here (case-insensitive), splitting on '&'/',' first so a collaboration counts if any one contributor is listed - see split_authors(). This is an opt-in allowlist, not a directory of every author in the catalog - there's no requirement for an author to appear here at all, and no false entries are kept (an author simply absent is untrusted). Add a name here (set to true) to mark it trusted.
